desc: Compute `dp_i = 1 + max(dp_j)` for `j < i` and `A_j < A_i` using coordinate-compressed max-Fenwick operations.
Answer static dominance queries offline by increasing `R`, maintaining a max-Fenwick tree over values for inserted positions.
Implement upper-bound lookup for arbitrary `X_i`, duplicate-safe max updates, and buffered Python I/O.
Verify correctness and `O((N+Q) log N)` time / `O(N+Q)` memory, including provided samples.
